_doc: #1693 SIGN-IN OWNER policy. Cloud Account (ac_cloud-account) is the ONLY fleet app that starts a sign-in. Every other app keeps its sign-in row in place (rule 16) but the row opens Cloud Account at that provider's page, and the app reads the credential / token / session state back from Cloud Account over the fleet IPC (Cloud Account's vault syncer stays the store). Consumed by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-sign-in-owner-guard.py, which fails for every sign-in starter outside the owner that no exemption below covers, and for every exemption that matches nothing any more. Adding a rule, an exemption or a root is a DATA edit here; nothing in the script names an app.
_rule: one place signs in: Cloud Account; every other app links to it and reads the result over IPC.

owner_impl.ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/auth: libs:auth IS the sign-in implementation (device grants, the SignInWays surface) Cloud Account hosts; callers of its surface elsewhere are caught by the signin-ui rule.
owner_impl.ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/gh: libs:gh is the gh engine process (Cloud-Lib-Gh.apk) that runs gh auth login when the owner asks; #1692 keeps its login keeper. Who asks it is caught by engine-login-call and engine-login-decl.

owner_must_hold.why: Cloud Account hosts the Account page whose Connect lines are the fleet's one sign-in

_doc_skip_path_parts: Tests may name a sign-in to prove the link and the IPC read; they start nothing on a phone.

engine-login-call.why: asks the gh engine to start a sign-in

engine-login-decl.why: declares a gh engine binding that drives a sign-in (engines.gh login timings)

credential-prompt.why: prompts for a password on a sign-in page

exempt.why: SuperApp's engines.gh binding drives Account > GitHub > WebAuth
the Account page Connect lines, shared by SuperApp and Cloud Account; gated to the owner in step 2
Account > Sign-in providers page, shared; gated to the owner in step 2
GitHub WebAuth via the gh engine, shared; gated to the owner in step 2
Drive's engines.gh binding drives the Git card's GitHub sign-in
Drive Configs > Sign in hosts libs:auth
Drive Git: startGhLogin, cloud fallback sign-in, host password entry
Drive Git hosts: token/password for a self-hosted git host
Cloud Mail Connect (IMAP/JMAP password, OAuth device grant) and account auth settings
libs:mail sign-in (SuperApp Mail page): same migration as Cloud Mail
Bitwarden login: Cloud Vault IS the credential store Cloud Account's vault syncer reads (architect decision)
Element X upstream Matrix login (password / OIDC); kept as an upstream login with a Sign in via Cloud Account entry where the protocol allows
Acode upstream auth and custom-tabs plugins; kept as an upstream login
libs:chat Mattermost password login (SuperApp Chat page)
libs:ops Dagu bearer token entry on its connect page
libs:git-ui GitHub token paste
libs:scraper music service device grant (MusicAuth)
Cloud Browser saved-passwords editor: stores site passwords, starts no fleet sign-in
KG Store token entry on its Me page
Cloud Me Buro screen secret entry
Cloud Tasks settings secret entry (CalDAV)

_doc_exempt: Each entry: a path prefix, the rules it may still trip, why, and `until` (the #1693 migration step that removes it, or `permanent` with the reason). An entry that matches nothing fails the guard, so a migrated app must drop its entry in the same commit: the list only shrinks.
